metadata.question: Were Shebelle River's levels higher on May 9, 2018 in comparison to May 17,2015?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
   - AOI: A rectangle around the Shebelle River near Beledweyne, Somalia (4.65–4.88N, 45.12–45.31E).
   - Primary data: Sentinel-1 GRD (VV) within ±6 days of target date; if empty, widen to ±15 days.
   - Fallback: Landsat 8 L2 SR within same windows, choose least CLOUD_COVER.
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
   - Sentinel-1: no clouds; detect water by VV backscatter threshold (-17 dB).
   - Landsat 8: QA_PIXEL cloud/shadow/cirrus/dilated mask; compute MNDWI > 0.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
   - If no images for a date even after widening and fallback => C1.
   - If images exist but valid pixel count after masking == 0 => C2.
   - If area is null/NaN => C3.
   - Otherwise compare water area (proxy for river level): 2018 > 2015 => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([45.12, 4.65, 45.31, 4.88]); // Shebelle River near Beledweyne
    const t2015 = ee.Date('2015-05-17');
    const t2018 = ee.Date('2018-05-09');
    const scale = 1000; // per requirement
    const maxPix = 1e9;

    async function sizeOf(col) { return await col.size().getInfo(); }

    function s1Collection(date, days) {
      const start = date.advance(-days, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(days + 1, 'day');
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'));
    }

    function pickClosest(col, date) {
      return ee.Image(col.map(function(im) {
        const diff = im.date().difference(date, 'day').abs();
        return im.set('diff', diff);
      }).sort('diff').first());
    }

    function l8Collection(date, days) {
      const start = date.advance(-days, 'day');
      const end = date.advance(days + 1, 'day');
      return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate(start, end);
    }

    function maskScaleL8(image) {
      const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);
      const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);
      const mask = dilated.or(cirrus).or(cloud).or(shadow).not();
      const sr = image.select(['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      return image.addBands(sr, null, true).updateMask(mask);
    }

    async function analyzeDate(dateStr) {
      const date = ee.Date(dateStr);
      // Try S1 ±6 then ±15 days
      let col = s1Collection(date, 6);
      let n = await sizeOf(col);
      let usedWindow = '±6d';
      if (n === 0) { col = s1Collection(date, 15); n = await sizeOf(col); usedWindow = '±15d'; }
      if (n > 0) {
        const img = pickClosest(col, date);
        const vv = img.select('VV');
        const vvDb = vv.log10().multiply(10).rename('VV');
        const valid = await vvDb.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
        }).get('VV').getInfo();
        if (valid && valid > 0) {
          const threshold = -17; // dB, robust simple threshold
          const water = vvDb.lt(threshold);
          const waterPix = await vvDb.updateMask(water).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
          }).get('VV').getInfo();
          const waterArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(water).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
          }).get('area').getInfo();
          const selDate = await img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
          return {
            source: 'S1', window: usedWindow, imgs: n, selDate: selDate,
            valid: valid || 0, waterPix: waterPix || 0,
            areaKm2: waterArea ? waterArea / 1e6 : null,
            cloud: null
          };
        }
        // else fall through to Landsat
      }
      // Fallback: Landsat 8
      col = l8Collection(date, 6);
      n = await sizeOf(col);
      let usedWindowL8 = '±6d';
      if (n === 0) { col = l8Collection(date, 15); n = await sizeOf(col); usedWindowL8 = '±15d'; }
      if (n === 0) {
        return { error: 'C1', note: 'Empty Collection' };
      }
      col = col.map(maskScaleL8).sort('CLOUD_COVER');
      const img = ee.Image(col.first());
      const cloudPct = await img.get('CLOUD_COVER').getInfo();
      const valid = await img.select('SR_B3').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
      }).get('SR_B3').getInfo();
      if (!valid || valid === 0) {
        return { error: 'C2', note: 'No Valid Pixels after cloud mask' };
      }
      const green = img.select('SR_B3');
      const swir1 = img.select('SR_B6');
      const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1));
      const water = mndwi.gt(0.0);
      const waterPix = await mndwi.updateMask(water).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
      }).get('SR_B3').getInfo();
      const waterArea = await ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(water).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
      }).get('area').getInfo();
      const selDate = await img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo();
      return {
        source: 'L8', window: usedWindowL8, imgs: n, selDate: selDate,
        valid: valid || 0, waterPix: waterPix || 0,
        areaKm2: waterArea ? waterArea / 1e6 : null,
        cloud: cloudPct
      };
    }

    // AOI area for context
    const aoiAreaKm2 = (await ee.Image.pixelArea().reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPix, bestEffort: true
    }).get('area').getInfo()) / 1e6;
    console.log(`AOI area km²: ${aoiAreaKm2.toFixed(2)}`);

    // Analyze both dates
    const r2015 = await analyzeDate('2015-05-17');
    if (r2015.error === 'C1') { console.log(`2015-05-17: No images (S1/L8) in windows.`); console.log('C1'); return; }
    if (r2015.error === 'C2') { console.log(`2015-05-17: Images exist but 0 valid pixels after masking.`); console.log('C2'); return; }
    if (!r2015.areaKm2 || isNaN(r2015.areaKm2)) { console.log(`2015-05-17: Calculation failure.`); console.log('C3'); return; }

    const r2018 = await analyzeDate('2018-05-09');
    if (r2018.error === 'C1') { console.log(`2018-05-09: No images (S1/L8) in windows.`); console.log('C1'); return; }
    if (r2018.error === 'C2') { console.log(`2018-05-09: Images exist but 0 valid pixels after masking.`); console.log('C2'); return; }
    if (!r2018.areaKm2 || isNaN(r2018.areaKm2)) { console.log(`2018-05-09: Calculation failure.`); console.log('C3'); return; }

    // Print concise stats
    const line2015 = `2015-05-17 ${r2015.source} imgs:${r2015.imgs} win:${r2015.window} sel:${r2015.selDate}` +
      ` valid:${r2015.valid} waterPix:${r2015.waterPix} area_km2:${r2015.areaKm2.toFixed(3)}` +
      (r2015.cloud != null ? ` cloud%:${r2015.cloud}` : '');
    const line2018 = `2018-05-09 ${r2018.source} imgs:${r2018.imgs} win:${r2018.window} sel:${r2018.selDate}` +
      ` valid:${r2018.valid} waterPix:${r2018.waterPix} area_km2:${r2018.areaKm2.toFixed(3)}` +
      (r2018.cloud != null ? ` cloud%:${r2018.cloud}` : '');
    console.log(line2015);
    console.log(line2018);
    console.log(`Water area comparison (km²): 2018=${r2018.areaKm2.toFixed(3)} vs 2015=${r2015.areaKm2.toFixed(3)}`);

    // Decision
    const higher = r2018.areaKm2 > r2015.areaKm2;
    console.log(higher ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
